models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Registered user accounts for the Todo List application.

Each record uniquely identifies an end user by email and handles all authentication, authorization, and session initiation actions. Stores password hash for credential validation (never raw password). Designed for personal and private account management, ensuring 100% data isolation from other users. All user actions against Todos trace back to this table. Enforces uniqueness on email and supports audit and compliance requirements for minimal user data retention.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Universally unique identifier for this user account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for user login and correspondence. Must be globally unique per requirements.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt, Argon2 or similar salted password hash. Never store plaintext passwords. Used only for login validation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of account creation (ISO8601, always present).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of most recent account update (ISO8601, always present).

plainFields.name: disabled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the account was administratively disabled (nullable; null means active).

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
User session records for authenticated access tracking.

Each session entry records a specific authenticated connection by a user, supporting full audit and security best practices. Tracks creation and expiry with environment/context fields for compliance. Sessions can be invalidated (expired_at) either by timeout, logout, or security events. Only references the user table for data isolation, never other session/user types. Auditable for every access as required by system policies.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this user session record.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated user for this session. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address at session initiation. Captured for audit and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (origin) for session. Provides traceability for session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Client referrer URL at session start. Used for security and compliance investigation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of session creation (ISO8601).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was terminated, expired, or forcibly ended by security policy (nullable if still active).

models.name: todo_list_admins
models.description:
Platform administrator accounts with privileged access over all user data and Todos.

Admin records support authentication, credential management, and audit/compliance oversight. Each admin account has its own unique email and secure password hash; no mixing with user roles is permitted. Administrators can log in for support, moderation, or audit functions. Disabling of admin accounts is allowed for compliance and incident response. All admin actions in the system are attributable to records in this table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Universally unique identifier for admin account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique admin account email, used for login and audit tracking.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed admin password for credential validation. Raw passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp recording when admin account was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last admin account update.

plainFields.name: disabled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when admin account was deactivated or disabled for compliance/security.

models.name: todo_list_admin_sessions
models.description:
Administrator session records for system and data access tracking.

Tracks individual admin logins and session histories with context fields (IP, href, referrer). Sessions are recorded independently of user sessions and only reference admin account table. Full audit trail for all administrative access, in support of compliance and incident response requirements. Sessions may be rendered inactive via expired_at when forcibly terminated or logged out.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Globally unique identifier for this admin session.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator owning this session. {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address for audit, risk management, and geo/country tracking.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Session initiation URL for context/audit.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at session start for anomaly or attack detection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session start timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When session ended/expired. Null means currently active session.

models.name: todo_list_password_reset_tokens
models.description:
Password reset tokens for secure credential recovery flows.

Each record stores a per-user, one-time-use token valid for password reset. Tokens are securely generated, time-limited, and are tightly linked to a specific user. Only valid, unexpired, and unused tokens may be applied for recovering access to a user account. Used token records remain in the system for audit trail purposes. This table is solely for credential reset/recovery and not for login/session flows.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier per token record.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to user who owns this reset token. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Reset token string. Securely random, used only for password reset operations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was created.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime, after which further use is forbidden.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of use (if any). Null means token unused and active.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
User-created task (Todo) entity representing an individual actionable item in a personal task list.

Each todo belongs to exactly one registered user and records essential details such as title, optional description, due date, and business status (pending, completed, or deleted). Provides complete auditability with timestamps for creation, modification, deletion, and completion event. This model enforces strict user-only ownership and visibility, supporting full CRUD lifecycle and compliance audit via foreign references. Referential integrity protects against orphaned records and ensures privacy.

Supporting indexes enable fast lookups by owner, status, and due date for responsive user flows. All behaviors align with minimal, privacy-focused product requirements and EARS-specified business rules.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Universally unique identifier for each todo record.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. Must point to an existing user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo item title. Required, non-empty text up to 100 characters. Validation enforced on creation and update to maintain business constraints.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive text (max 500 characters). May be null or omitted if not provided by user.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Todo status: allowed values are 'pending', 'completed', or 'deleted'. Used for business workflow, filtering, and access control. Status changes follow task lifecycle state machine.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo. Must be today or future, if present. Used for sorting and reminders.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking the moment the todo was marked as completed by the user. Null if not completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of initial creation. Immutable after insert.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update. Modified on every business change or status transition.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the todo was soft deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: todo_list_admin_audit_logs
models.description:
Administrative action and compliance audit log capturing all critical administrative interactions with user or todo data.

Stores immutable, append-only audit trail entries recording which admin performed which tracked action (create, update, access, delete, etc.), on what entity (user, todo), and with what context. Each log links the actor (admin), optionally impacted user, and target todo (if any), supporting detailed compliance and accountability reviews. Fields include mandatory timestamps, request metadata, and detailed action descriptors. Indexes support rapid security, audit, and compliance queries.

Never contains business entity data itself; provides operational transparency without cross-contaminating business state.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Universally unique audit log entry identifier.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin actor who performed the action. Always points to a valid admin. {@link todo_list_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User affected by the action, if applicable. May be null for purely admin system operations. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: Related todo item if the action targets a specific task. Null if the action does not pertain to a specific todo. {@link todo_list_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Categorical action label (e.g., 'create', 'update', 'delete', 'access'). Defines the type of operation performed by admin.

plainFields.name: request_context
plainFields.description: Optional extended, machine-readable metadata about the admin request context (e.g., IP, session, endpoint). Useful for forensics and compliance situations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the audit log record was created. Immutable and set automatically at write time.
